name: Win-Back
goal: Bring past customers back for their next millwork project with ideas, what's new and help that answers their questions, and be honest about emailing less if they aren't ready.
trigger: Segment-triggered (Klaviyo 'Added to segment'): the profile enters the 'Lapsed customers' segment. The segment is Placed Order at least once over all time AND Placed Order zero times in the last 180 days AND Active on Site zero times in the last 60 days. For pros (customer_type is contractor, builder, designer or architect) the window is zero times in the last 120 days.
flow_filters: Placed Order zero times since starting this flow.

Has been in Cart & Checkout Abandonment (CRT), Browse Abandonment (BRW), Back in Stock + Price Drop (BIS), Sample-to-Order (SMP) and Depot Dollars Expiring (DD) zero times since starting this flow. If they're back on the site, the higher-priority flow takes over.
Has been in this flow zero times in the last 365 days.
exit_conditions: Enters a higher-priority flow (CRT, BRW, BIS, SMP or DD).
Unsubscribes from email: the email steps stop but WIN-S1 still sends if SMS-consented. Replies STOP: S1 is skipped but the emails still send.
Completes WIN-E3. Profiles that don't click move to the lower-frequency campaign segment described in build_notes.
smart_sending: Email on (16h) / SMS on (24h). This is the program default. Win-Back is near the bottom of the priority order, so it should always give way to higher-priority flows.

branches.label: All lapsed customers
branches.rule: No split. Pros enter on a 120-day site-inactivity window instead of 60, which is set in the segment. Each email step has a conditional split that skips profiles with email_sunset = true.

kpis.metric: Reactivation rate (order within 30 days of entry)
kpis.target: 3% (starting benchmark; reset after 90 days of data)
Set a baseline in the first 90 days

build_notes: Segment 'Lapsed customers': (Placed Order at least once over all time) AND (Placed Order zero times in the last 180 days) AND ((customer_type is not in [contractor, builder, designer, architect] AND Active on Site zero times in the last 60 days) OR (customer_type is in [contractor, builder, designer, architect] AND Active on Site zero times in the last 120 days)). Active on Site needs Klaviyo's onsite tracking on the Miva storefront. If that isn't live, substitute Viewed Product zero times over the same windows.

Re-entry: a customer should go through Win-Back at most once every 365 days (flow filter). Confirm how Klaviyo handles re-entry for segment-triggered flows. If profiles can't re-enter, rebuild the trigger as a scheduled check or clone the flow each year.

Depot Dollars: everyone in this flow last ordered 180+ days ago, and Depot Dollars expire 90 days after they're earned, so their earned balance has expired. Never say 'you have Depot Dollars' and never show {{ depot_dollars_balance }} here. The copy only talks about what the next order earns (5% back).

{{ WINBACK_INCENTIVE }} (default 'bonus Depot Dollars') appears only in WIN-E3. Before launch, set the amount, an end date, exclusions and how bonus Depot Dollars are issued in Miva (manual credit, coupon or rule). If you add an end date, add it to the E3 callout. Under the discount guardrails, never use a percentage off on made-to-order items (vinyl and wood shutters, Design Your Own builder items, made-to-order beams). If the incentive is not approved, send the E3 no-incentive alt version.

Make E3's 'we'll write less often' promise true. After E3, wait 7 days, then use a conditional split on Clicked Email zero times since starting this flow AND Placed Order zero times since starting. On the YES path, use Update Profile Property winback_low_frequency = true. Recommendation: campaign segments send these profiles major sales and new-product launches only (about 2 a month). Clear the property when they click, visit or order. If they stay unengaged, the Sunset flow takes over at 120 days.
email_sunset: put a conditional split before each email (email_sunset is not true). Sunset profiles skip the emails but can still get WIN-S1 if SMS-consented.

WIN-E2 products block: needs a 'new' tag or a created date in the Klaviyo catalog feed. If neither exists, replace the block with Klaviyo's 'recommended for you' feed for the category they bought before, and change the block title to 'Picked for your next project'.

What's new is limited to verified items: the new generation of Timberthane faux wood ('even more realistic, still maintenance-free'), wall and ceiling motif kits, slat wall kits, new shutter styles and SteelTek hardware. Don't add sizes, finishes, prices or launch dates unless they're pulled from the live product pages. Point the kit and shutter cards at their category pages once those URLs are verified. For now they go to /ekena-millwork.html.
SMS: WIN-S1 goes out on day 10 at 1pm recipient local time, inside the 10am-8pm quiet-hours window, and counts toward the 3-per-rolling-7-days cap. It carries no incentive.
Images: real Ekena product photography only. The E1 hero should feature new-generation Timberthane beams.

steps.purpose: The last nudge, with a thank-you incentive (bonus Depot Dollars by default) and answers to the questions that stall a project. Say plainly that we'll email less after this, so the relationship ends on good terms if they aren't ready.

hero.headline: A little extra for your next project
hero.subhead: {{ WINBACK_INCENTIVE }} on your next order at Architectural Depot.
hero.image: Close detail of hands fitting a corbel under a mantel shelf, warm interior light. Real Ekena product photography.

blocks.text: Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }}, we know a millwork project isn't something you buy every month. So here's one last nudge, with a thank-you attached for coming back to us.

blocks.title: Your thank-you
blocks.text: {{ WINBACK_INCENTIVE }} on your next order. Bonus Depot Dollars work like regular ones: each takes $1 off a future order, not including shipping, handling or tax.

items: **Not sure of the size?** Product pages list dimensions and specs, and we're glad to check your measurements by phone.
**Need a custom size?** Design Your Own builders handle corbels, brackets, flat trim and faux wood beams.
**Want to see it first?** Order a [material sample](https://www.architecturaldepot.com/SAMPLE-URETHANE.html) and hold it up in your own space.
**Found a lower price?** If another online home improvement store has the exact same product for less (shipping included, shippable within 10 business days), we'll refund the difference.

blocks.text: And if now isn't the time, that's okay. After this email we'll write less often. Want to choose what you hear about? {% manage_preferences %}

steps.ps: Rather talk it through? Call 1-888-573-3768, Mon-Fri 8am-6pm CT and Sat 8am-12pm CT.
